money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; original EMD to reach office by 23.07.2025 15:00. QCBS evaluation.

eligibility: Registered office for architectural consultancy services in India for at least 5 years
Similar work for Central/State Govt organizations in last 7 financial years: one work >= 80%, or two each >= 50%, or three each >= 40% of estimated cost; value enhanced at 7% per annum
Similar works: architectural and structural consultancy for infrastructure development, tourism development, river bank area development or other development works, or multistoried buildings in India
Firm/designated architect registered with Council of Architecture
Evidence of employing 1 Senior Architect (B.Arch, >= 5 years) and 2 Junior Architects (B.Arch, >= 2 years)/Civil Engineers (B.Tech)
Undertaking to sign MoU with a structural design firm, with designs proof checked by a reputed research institution/Government department, at agreement signing
PAN, GST registration, notarized non-blacklisting affidavit (2025), unconditional price bid undertaking, ITR for 2021-22 to 2023-24, tender acceptance letter
